name: Nitidulid beetle
description_damage: Nitidulid beetles are rarely a pest of snap beans and rarely require treatment. Adult beetles are small and black. They infest blossoms from mid-July to mid-August. They may cause blossom drop, but control is unnecessary unless populations are very high. Nitidulid beetles are shiny black beetles about 0.19 inch long. The pollen-seeking adults damage flowers. Browned flowers are unattractive to pollinators.

chemical_home: No products are registered for control of this pest.
chemical_commercial: Most insecticides labeled for use on green beans for aphids or other pest of.beans reduce nitidulid beetle populations.
Effective chemicals previously used for control are no longer registered for use. pyrethrins/piperonyl
butoxide (Pyronyl Crop Spray) at 0.004 to 0.050 lb ai/A. PHI 0 days. REI 12 hr. Do not exceed 10 applications per season. Minimum retreatment interval 3 days.

source_section: Hosts and Pests of Vegetable Crops
